_notes.purpose: Week renders for WeekHeroImage / HeroSubject (public/assets/semanas/bebe-<week>.webp, weeks 3–42). Transparent PNG sources; convert with npm run optimize:images per public/assets/semanas/README.md. Plus the 40 size-comparison objects (public/assets/comparaciones/<slug>.webp, slugs from lib/seed/comparisons.ts) regenerated 2026-09-23 on a transparent background — the 2026-09-21 set sat on coloured squares and never reached the repo.
_notes.style: Flat editorial picture-book illustration matching the 40 size-comparison fruits made 2026-09-21. Weeks 3–4 glow/seed, 5–8 embryo, 9–27 curled baby, 28–42 wrapped in a sage muslin blanket (late-term unwrapped prompts were blocked by the provider's safety filter).
_notes.resolution_rule: 1:1 medium 1k — shown at most ~300 px wide on phones.
_notes.cost_preflight: 0.5 credits per image (gpt_image_2_5 sunburst, medium, 1k, 1:1, transparent)
_notes.actual_spend_credits: ~42.5 (weeks: 40 kept + 3 blocked + 2 superseded pilots ≈ 22.5; comparisons: 40 kept = 20; blocked or rate-limited submissions are not charged)
_notes.download_status: awaiting-allowlist — this cloud environment gets CONNECT 403 for *.cloudfront.net. Add it under the environment's Network access → Allowed domains, then run `npm run localize:images` and commit public/assets/semanas/*.webp and public/assets/comparaciones/*.webp.
_notes.review: Founder to approve both sets in the Higgsfield gallery before localizing; medical reviewer optional (stylised, non-anatomical).

images.alt_es: Ilustración: el inicio del embarazo en la semana 3
images.prompt: Warm flat editorial illustration in a gentle children's picture-book style, soft organic shapes, subtle paper-grain texture, hand-drawn outline in deep petrol green (#2F5D50). Palette: warm peach (#F4D3C2, #EFC6B0), blush pink (#F3DAD4) cheek, petrol green lines. Subject: the very first days of a pregnancy, week 3, drawn as a tiny soft round cluster of cells like a small glowing berry, with a gentle warm glow around it. Simplified shapes, no anatomical detail. Centred with generous empty margin, isolated on a fully transparent background. No umbilical cord, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Avoid: photorealism, 3D, gradients, medical diagram look.
